sources.snippet: Training on DROID Data Relevant source files This document describes the complete workflow for training and fine-tuning OpenPI models on the DROID dataset. DROID is a large-scale robot manipulation dataset (10k+ hours, ~75k episodes) that requires specialized data loading infrastructure and filtering techniques.
